description: This file defines API routes for task management in a FastAPI application, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting tasks. It utilizes SQLAlchemy for database interactions and includes route handlers that respond with task data or raise HTTP exceptions.

methods.name: create_task( task_in: task_schema.TaskCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint to create a new task in the database.

methods.name: read_tasks( skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint to retrieve a list of tasks with optional pagination.

methods.name: read_task( task_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint to retrieve a single task by its ID, with 404 error if not found.

methods.name: update_task( task_id: int, task_in: task_schema.TaskUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint to update an existing task by its ID, with 404 error if not found.

methods.name: delete_task( task_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint to delete a task by its ID, with 404 error if not found.
